evals.name: retrofit-hoa-default-ahj-duke
evals.prompt: Generate the Zoho Projects template for a residential retrofit: PV + Tesla battery, NC, Wake County AHJ, Duke Energy Progress, HOA approval required, LightReach lease.
evals.expected_output: Four sections in order. Wake not in lookup table so default AHJ row is flagged. Milestone days match compute_timeline.py: design 8, permit 25, HOA 40, install 40-58, as-built 61, inspections 64, energized 67, interconnection and grid export 78, project end 84, customer estimate 116. HOA tasks and NCUC included; Enphase labor reimbursement excluded with reason. JSON counts match outline. No Zoho writes attempted before confirmation.
assertions: Output has the four sections: assumptions, outline, JSON spec, build notes, in that order
Assumptions state that Wake is not in the AHJ table and the default row was used
Install starts on day 40 because HOA approval is later than the permit (day 25)
Total duration is stated as 84 days
Enphase labor reimbursement is listed as excluded because the inverter is not Enphase
Build notes say phases and dependency links cannot be created by the connector and give manual steps
Task count in the outline equals the number of tasks in the JSON
No tool call creates or updates anything in Zoho Projects

evals.name: retrofit-no-hoa-horry-sc
evals.prompt: Build me a retrofit template for a PV-only Enphase job in Horry County, SC. Utility is Horry Electric. No HOA.
evals.expected_output: Specific Horry County and Horry Electric rows used (both rest on 2 projects, so low-confidence flags, no default fallback). No HOA block. Enphase labor reimbursement included. NCUC excluded because state is SC. Battery fields N/A.
assertions: HOA tasks are listed as excluded and install start is driven by the permit
NCUC Submitted is excluded because the state is SC
Sign up for Service Labor Reimbursement is included because the inverter is Enphase
AHJ row is Horry County and utility row is Horry Electric, each with a low-confidence note
Numbers match the output of scripts/compute_timeline.py for these inputs

evals.name: ev-charger-missing-data
evals.prompt: Make a template for EV charger installs.
evals.expected_output: Asks once, briefly, for the task chain or a comparable live project, noting there is no usable EV history. Does not invent a full task chain from the retrofit data.
assertions: Asks at most one brief clarifying question rather than generating a full template immediately
States that no EV task data exists
Does not present retrofit durations as validated EV durations

evals.name: determinism-rerun
evals.prompt: Generate the retrofit template for Pender County, Duke Energy Progress, no HOA, NC, Enphase, PV only. (Run this twice in separate sessions and diff the JSON.)
evals.expected_output: Identical IDs, ordering, names, and numbers across runs.
assertions: Two runs produce JSON that is identical apart from whitespace
IDs are sequential with no gaps after excluded blocks
